{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Lost Glitch''' was a fast enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It was a stronger version of the [[Null Runner]], boasting higher health but slightly slower speed than it. ==Logbook Description== "''The Lost Glitch is an enraged enemy that embodies the [[Nil Zone]]'s instability. It relentlessly hunts [[Null Runner]]s, who have learned to run at the sight of it. The creature's very existence appears to cause it pain, as it evolved from the same thing that it hunts.''" ==Appearance== The '''Lost Glitch''' is an evolved [[Null Runner]]. It has a thin body with purple skin. Tendrils sprout from its body, with a slightly more saturated color. It has an exposed set of teeth, which are slightly yellowed. Its joints are slightly more saturated - with them being its elbows, knees and midsection. It has a dome-like head, with no eyes and white veins. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Minigunner]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Accelerator]] can be used to take this down rather easily. *As the '''Lost Glitch''' is quite fast, stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be quite useful against this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Halloween 2025 Trailer|'''Lost Glitch''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Lost Glitch''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. LostGlitchIconIG.png|'''Lost Glitch''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Lost Glitch''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Lost Glitch''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Lost Glitch''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Lost Glitch''' has no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]], causing it to break. *''' 19 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0|v1.77.3a]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Now appears in [[Banlands]]. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Lost Glitch''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Lost Glitch''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{Outpost16|[[Null Crook Boss]]|Wave 7|Lost Glitch|Wave 9|[[Null Freezer]]|Wave 11}} {{Banlands|[[Null Shrieker]]|Wave 7 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Null Scout]]|hardw1 = Wave 6 (Hard)|Lost Glitch|Wave 8|[[Null Crook Boss]]|Wave 10}} {{BlindFaith|[[Null Scout]] & [[Null Dredge]]|Wave 1|[[Null Runner]] & Lost Glitch|Wave 2|[[Nulling]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
